Content Understanding: Limited or inaccurate grasp of key concepts.
Solid grasp; explains and supports ideas with appropriate evidence.
Comprehensive grasp; applies concepts to solve the scenario, including in complex or extended situations.
Application of Performance Indicators an: Names them but understanding is incomplete or wrong.
Defines them but does not connect them to the scenario's objective.
Explains them and connects them to solve the objective.
Applies them strategically to solve the objective comprehensively.
Reasoning: Unclear, inaccurate or unsupported ideas; no application.
Somewhat logical ideas with gaps in reasoning or evidence.
Logical, well-developed, supported ideas with only minor gaps.
Logical, well-supported with business concepts/theory; clearly practical and real-world relevant.
Workplace Readiness: Like an employee who needs significant guidance.
Like an employee who handles routine tasks with some guidance.
Like an employee who works independently and effectively.
Like an advanced employee who works independently and adapts to new or unpredictable challenges.
